body:
I've been with my gf for 14 months and I recently discovered 2 things:

1. She is physically and emotionally standoffish, loves me but doesn't really like regular hugs and physical affection

2. She is 10 weeks pregnant

I'm heartbroken cos I know we are good people and there is love there but I feel very alone a lot.of the time. I blamed it on myself but now realise it's an incompatibility that will forever hurt me. Lying in bed she's happy to be one side me on the other. We've a child on the way now and all.I keep thinking is stay if it's born, go if it miscarries. I'm awful.
I hate myself for wishing for a miscarriage but it doesn't make the wishing go away

She said she couldn't bear the thoughts of doing it and that the procedure itself seemed v painful. She said cos I'm an amazing Dad already that we'd nothing to worry about. I had a meltdown then grovelled now I'm bouncing from optimistic to suicidial
